Algorithm 1 Dual-Path Condition Alignment Batch Step
1: Input: DDT \(v_{\theta}\), batch of \(B\) flow examples \(F = \{(\mathbf{x}_1, y_1), \ldots, (\mathbf{x}_B, y_B)\}\), projector \(z_{\phi}\), learning rate \(\beta\), sampling times \(K = 2\) and hyperparameter \(\lambda = 0.5\).
2: Output: Updated model parameters \(\theta\).
3: \(L(\theta, \phi) = 0\)
4: for \(i\) in range(\(B\)) do
5:    for \(j\) in range(\(K\)) do
6:    \(t_j \sim U(0,1)\), \(\epsilon_j \sim \mathcal{N}(0,1)\), \(\mathbf{x}_{t_j} = \alpha_{t_j} \mathbf{x}_i + \sigma_{t_j} \epsilon_j\)
7:    \(\hat{\mathbf{v}}_j, \mathbf{z}_j = v_\theta(\mathbf{x}_{t_j}, t_j, y_i)\), \(\mathbf{v}_j = \dot{\alpha}_{t_j} \mathbf{x}_i + \dot{\sigma}_{t_j} \epsilon_j\)
8:    \(\mathbf{z}_j = z_{\phi}(\mathbf{z}_j)\)
9:    \(L(\theta, \phi) += ||\hat{\mathbf{v}}_j - \mathbf{v}_j||^2\)
10:    for \(k\) in range(\(j\)) do
11:    \(L(\theta, \phi) - = \frac{2\lambda}{K(K-1)} \cdot \text{sim}(\mathbf{z}_k, \mathbf{z}_j)\)
12:    end for
13:    end for
14: end for
15: \(\theta \leftarrow \theta - \frac{\beta}{B} \nabla_\theta L(\theta, \phi)\), \(\phi \leftarrow \phi - \frac{\beta}{B} \nabla_\phi L(\theta, \phi)\)
